hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook for an ETH/SATO pair. Buys mint SATO via a forward curve and sells burn SATO via an inverse curve priced against accumulated ETH reserves held by the hook. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; the hook intercepts all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta, acting as sole counterparty and collecting a 0.3% fee.
